chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 193 – The Reluctant Trade
chapter_meta_description: Han Li meets Zhong Wu, a cunning Spirit Beast Mountain cultivator who recognizes the Cloud Treading Boots. A deadly standoff turns into a cold, calculated information swap. The Dark Forest rules apply.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 193 – Two Cultivators, One Pair of Boots, Zero Trust
og_description: Han Li admits to killing Feng Yue. Zhong Wu laughs it off. They trade jade slips like old friends, all while keeping a twenty-zhang distance. The Mortal Stream’s art of negotiation.
twitter_description: Han Li meets Zhong Wu. They don’t fight. They trade info. And they keep a twenty-zhang gap the whole time. Peak Mortal Stream diplomacy.
